step_by_step_reasoning: The visual diagram illustrates the decomposition of a monolithic data architecture into AWS purpose-built database and storage services. At the top, a container representing the OutSystems Monolith Platform categorizes data into Binary, Relational, Key-Value/Doc, and Encrypted types, which route directly to their respective AWS target services: S3, Aurora, DynamoDB, and Secrets Manager. At the bottom, AWS KMS provides encryption keys across S3, Aurora, DynamoDB, and Secrets Manager for multi-tenant data protection.
